title: Annotatio VI §.III: Easy to do likewise on other Antitheses — none damned in Scripture; opposites asserted
pass_a_gloss: Today’s Doctors will be induced most easily to do something similar on the other Antitheses mentioned above, if they recall that all those Antitheses of theirs and many like them are nowhere read damned in Holy Scripture, neither expressly nor by ready Consequence; nay rather that the Antitheses of these Antitheses are asserted in the word of God, if not in just so many words, certainly by legitimate Consequences:
pass_b_english: Today’s doctors would be led most easily to do the same on the other antitheses named above.
They need only recall that none of those antitheses — nor many like them — is read damned in Holy Scripture, either expressly or by ready consequence.
Rather, the antitheses of those antitheses are asserted in God’s word, if not in the same words, then by legitimate consequence.
source_text: Ad simile quid faciendum in aliis suprà memoratis Antithesibus inducentur hodierni Doctores quàm facillimè, si recolant, omnes istas Antitheses suas similesque plures, in Scriptura S. nullibi, nec expressè, nec per Consequentiam obviam, damnatas legi; quin harum potius Antithesium Antitheses, si minus totidem verbis, certè per legitimas Consequentias, in verbo Dei asseri:
notes: Other Antitheses easy likewise; not damned in Scripture; opposites asserted.
